notes: The second 'me' (t007) is marked added rather than folded into the causative verb, following rule 44's ruling that a supplied object joins no verb.

Competing reading: the fronted object אוֹתִי serves both verbs, so the single suffix could take t004 and t007 as one discontinuous unit under rule 25. Rule 44 applied per verb was taken, since יֹּלַךְ carries no object morpheme of its own.
